title: PSScriptAnalyzer + approved verbs
summary: Установлен PSScriptAnalyzer. Создан .pspsscriptanalyzer.psd1 с Severity=Error/Warning и ExcludeRules (PSAvoidUsingWriteHost, PSUseShouldProcessForStateChangingFunctions, PSUseDeclaredVarsMoreThanAssignment, PSUseBOMForUnicodeEncodedFile). Скрипт scripts/lint.ps1 вызывает Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer. Функции переименованы в approved verbs: Set-Symlink, Remove-Entry, Remove-ItemLogged, Update-Cursor.
